content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6-2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. Research shows gains level off around 1.6 g/kg, and going higher is optional. Spread it over 3-5 meals with roughly 0.3-0.4 g/kg each, and hit your total calories too, since a small surplus matters just as much for building muscle and pushing that 100 kg bench. 💪
